title: stardust coverage/claims.json
description: Parallel-agent lease file. Each agent claims a non-overlapping work unit (template cluster or page batch slice) and a frozen brief before working, so parallel agents cannot overlap, drift from the locked direction/canon, or take shortcuts. stardust:site is the only writer that grants/reclaims; agents update only their own claim's heartbeat and status.

id.description: Claim id; also the fragment filename coverage/fragments/<id>.json.

agent.description: Identifier of the agent holding the claim.

phase.description: Which pipeline phase this claim parallelizes.

ids.description: The exact, non-overlapping unit ids (template ids, slugs, or block ids) this agent owns.

frozenBrief.description: The pinned inputs the agent may use. site rejects a fragment at merge time if these shas no longer match the active direction/canon (catches a drifted or stale agent).

templateArchetype.description: Approved archetype slug the agent forks (Path A').

findingIds.description: The optimize findings in scope this agent is responsible for resolving. It may not mark findings outside this list fixed.

blockContract.description: Block ids + slot shapes the agent must honour without redefining.

invariants.description: The no-drift / no-shortcut rules re-checked by site at merge time. Declared here for auditability.

status.description: held = active; completed = fragment written & ready to merge; reclaimed = lease expired and reassigned; rejected = failed merge validation.

heartbeatAt.description: Updated by the agent; a stale heartbeat lets site reclaim the scope.

fragmentPath.description: coverage/fragments/<id>.json the agent wrote; merged by site.
